Our story

Everyday water, with a point of view.

Elixir is being built as a modern beverage brand where product, packaging and experience work together. The goal is simple: create hydration that looks as good as it feels to choose.

From the distinctive infinity identity to the bold bottle labels, Elixir is designed to be recognisable, memorable and ready to grow.

“Purely yours.” — the thought behind Elixir.
